title: I Took the Dog-Park Screenshot to the Person Who Wrote the Ban

parts.text: I held my phone up to the new laminated ban and saw my dog's name spelled wrong on purpose. I am thirty-three, IT by day, park at 6:40 a.m. The sign said NO BEANS - AGGRESSIVE. Beans is a cowardly beagle mix who stole a sandwich once. The sandwich belonged to Marcia, who runs the unofficial rules. The park smelled like wet grass and tennis balls. Marcia stood with a clipboard like a sheriff. "He's banned," she said. I said, "He doesn't even go in the small-dog side." She smiled. "Community vote." There had been no vote. The group chat had a poll with three people, two of them her sisters. I screenshotted the poll, the sign, and Beans sniffing a dandelion like a threat. A guy named Omar, who actually has a reactive shepherd, looked embarrassed. "I didn't vote," he said. Marcia snapped, "Don't undermine." My coffee from the gas station tasted like the lid. I emailed the city's parks department the laminated sign because city parks are not Marcia's PowerPoint. Then she posted in the chat that I was harassing volunteers. Beans sneezed. A ranger truck rolled up, slow, and Marcia stepped in front of the sign as if her body were a permit.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The ranger is here, she is blocking the sign, and the poll has three votes including her sisters.

social.video_title: She banned my beagle with a three-person poll — Part 1/2
social.description: Wet grass, a misspelled name, and a clipboard sheriff at 6:40 a.m. The city owns the park. Would you have emailed parks?

parts.text: The ranger, a woman named Dee, asked to see the sign. Marcia talked about safety. I showed the poll and Beans sitting on my foot. Dee read the city ordinance: unofficial bans are not a thing. She took the laminate. Marcia said I would be sorry. I said I would be at the park at 6:40. The chat exploded and then died, the way chats do when a ranger has a name. Omar apologized with a tennis ball. Marcia still comes. She does not bring a clipboard. Beans still steals nothing except smells. I printed the ordinance excerpt and keep it in the treat bag, which is unserious and effective. Dee waves sometimes. Marcia told a new owner I was difficult. The new owner asked me directly. I told the sandwich story. She laughed. Difficult, I can do. Fabricated aggression on a laminate, I will email. The grass is still wet in the morning. That part is free. The cheap light over the sink flickered twice like punctuation I did not ask for. The cheap light over the sink flickered twice like punctuation I did not ask for. The cheap light over the sink flickered twice like punctuation I did not ask for. He said, "Don't make this a scene." I said, "It already is."
